source_title: TMKOC's Dilip Joshi Wins 'Most Popular TV Performance In Comic Role' For Jethalal, Beats 14 Nominees
source_excerpt:
Dilip Joshi, who is best known for playing Jethalal Gada in Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah , has won the Most Popular TV Performance in a Comic Role title at the Indian Film & TV Awards (IFTA) 2026. Joshi secured 3,812 votes, accounting for 57.8% of all verified votes, outperforming the combined total of the other 14 nominees. The win highlights his enduring popularity among television audiences and the lasting appeal of his much-loved comic character, Jethalal.
The actor finished well ahead of his competitors, with his popular portrayal of Jethalal leading the voting across all age groups.

Dilip Joshi received 3,812 votes in the IFTA 2026 voting, while the remaining 14 nominees collectively secured 2,784 votes. His individual tally was significantly higher than the combined vote count of all his competitors, highlighting the strong support for his portrayal of Jethalal Gada in Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. The result placed Joshi comfortably ahead of the other contenders in the Most Popular TV Performance in a Comic Role category.
A post shared by IFTA | Indian Film & TV Awards (@ifta.official)
Krishna Bharadwaj, known for playing Tenali Rama in the television series of the same name, finished in second place with 786 votes.

Dilip Joshi topped the IFTA 2026 voting with 3,812 votes for his popular portrayal of Jethalal Gada in Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. Krishna Bharadwaj, who plays Tenali Rama, secured the second position with 786 votes. Sumeet Raghavan followed in third place with 341 votes for his role as Rajesh Wagle, while Shubhangi Atre received 333 votes for her portrayal of Angoori Bhabhi. Aasif Sheikh rounded off the top five with 310 votes, completing the list of the five highest-voted performers in the category.
